coverage.reason: The criterion is about which names src/index.ts exports. Breaking it means removing an export, which a witness calling an exported function cannot show, and mutants must not change exports.
coverage.text: THE Cart_Pricing_Library SHALL export `priceCart`, `percentOf`, and `ValidationError` as values from `src/index.ts`.

coverage.reason: The exported types Cart, Line, Coupon and Breakdown are erased at runtime, so no exported function can show their absence.
coverage.text: THE Cart_Pricing_Library SHALL export the types `Cart`, `Line`, `Coupon`, and `Breakdown` from `src/index.ts`.

coverage.reason: The Coupon union shape is a type-level definition erased at runtime, so no exported function output can differ.
coverage.text: THE Cart_Pricing_Library SHALL define the Coupon type as a union of a percent variant with `bps`, `maxDiscountCents`, and `minSubtotalCents`, and a fixed variant with `amountCents` and `minSubtotalCents`.

coverage.reason: The Breakdown field list is a type-level definition erased at runtime, and mutants must not change types.
coverage.text: THE Cart_Pricing_Library SHALL define the Breakdown type with the fields `subtotalCents`, `discountCents`, `shippingCents`, `taxCents`, and `totalCents`.

coverage.reason: Erasable-syntax-only is a property of the source text and compiler settings, not of any value an exported function returns.
coverage.text: THE Cart_Pricing_Library SHALL use only erasable TypeScript syntax, excluding enums and namespaces.
WHEN `percentOf` is called with a non-negative integer amount and a non-negative integer bps, THE Percent_Calculator SHALL return the amount multiplied by bps divided by 10000, using Round_Half_Up.
THE Percent_Calculator SHALL compute results using integer arithmetic only.
THE Percent_Calculator SHALL accept inputs without performing validation.

IF a Line `quantity` is not an integer between 1 and 999 inclusive, THEN THE Validator SHALL throw a ValidationError whose `field` is `lines[i].quantity`, where `i` is the zero-based index of the Line.

IF a Line `unitPriceCents` is not an integer between 0 and 1,000,000 inclusive, THEN THE Validator SHALL throw a ValidationError whose `field` is `lines[i].unitPriceCents`, where `i` is the zero-based index of the Line.
IF `taxBps` is not an integer between 0 and 10000 inclusive, THEN THE Validator SHALL throw a ValidationError whose `field` is `taxBps`.

coverage.reason: The criterion is about which invalid field the ValidationError names when several are invalid. A witness compares only the error class (expectedError), so it cannot show that the wrong or a valid field was named, and any input with several invalid fields is already rejected by the single-field criteria 3.1 to 3.3.
coverage.text: WHEN a Cart contains multiple invalid fields, THE Validator SHALL throw a ValidationError naming one of the invalid fields.
THE Validator SHALL accept Coupon field values without validation.

WHEN a Line has a `quantity` of 10 or more, THE Price_Calculator SHALL compute the bulk discount amount as `percentOf(raw, 1000)`, where `raw` is the Line's `quantity` multiplied by `unitPriceCents`, with the discount amount rounded using Round_Half_Up, and SHALL set the Line_Total to `raw` minus that bulk discount amount. For example, a Line with `quantity` 11 and `unitPriceCents` 5 has `raw` 55, a bulk discount amount of 6, and a Line_Total of 49.
WHEN a Line has a `quantity` below 10, THE Price_Calculator SHALL set the Line_Total to `quantity` multiplied by `unitPriceCents`.
THE Price_Calculator SHALL set `subtotalCents` to the sum of all Line_Total values.
WHEN the Cart contains zero Lines, THE Price_Calculator SHALL return a Breakdown in which every field equals 0.
WHEN a Coupon is present and the Subtotal is greater than or equal to the Coupon `minSubtotalCents`, THE Price_Calculator SHALL apply the Coupon discount.
IF a Coupon is present and the Subtotal is less than the Coupon `minSubtotalCents`, THEN THE Price_Calculator SHALL set `discountCents` to 0.
WHEN a percent Coupon applies, THE Price_Calculator SHALL compute the discount as `percentOf(subtotal, bps)` and limit the discount to `maxDiscountCents`.
WHEN a fixed Coupon applies, THE Price_Calculator SHALL set the discount to `amountCents`.
THE Price_Calculator SHALL limit `discountCents` to a value less than or equal to `subtotalCents`.
WHEN no Coupon is present, THE Price_Calculator SHALL set `discountCents` to 0.
WHEN the Cart contains zero Lines, THE Price_Calculator SHALL set `shippingCents` to 0.
WHERE the Shipping_Method is `standard` and the Cart contains at least one Line, THE Price_Calculator SHALL set `shippingCents` to 799 when the Discounted_Subtotal is below 10000.
WHERE the Shipping_Method is `standard` and the Cart contains at least one Line, THE Price_Calculator SHALL set `shippingCents` to 0 when the Discounted_Subtotal is 10000 or more.
WHERE the Shipping_Method is `express` and the Cart contains at least one Line, THE Price_Calculator SHALL set `shippingCents` to 1499.
THE Price_Calculator SHALL set `taxCents` to `percentOf(Discounted_Subtotal, taxBps)`.
THE Price_Calculator SHALL exclude `shippingCents` from the tax base.
THE Price_Calculator SHALL set `totalCents` to the Discounted_Subtotal plus `shippingCents` plus `taxCents`.
THE Price_Calculator SHALL return every Breakdown field as a non-negative integer.

coverage.reason: The criterion requires that test files exist under test/ and use property tests. It is about the test suite, not about the output of any exported function, so no witness can show a violation.
coverage.text: THE Cart_Pricing_Library SHALL include Vitest tests under `test/` that use fast-check property tests for the Breakdown invariants: non-negative integer fields, `discountCents` not exceeding `subtotalCents`, and `totalCents` equal to the Discounted_Subtotal plus `shippingCents` plus `taxCents`.

coverage.reason: The criterion requires that tests assert the field of each ValidationError. It is about the content of the test suite, not about the behaviour of any exported function.
coverage.text: THE Cart_Pricing_Library SHALL include tests that assert the `field` value of each ValidationError case in Requirement 3.

coverage.reason: The criterion requires that tests cover Round_Half_Up at exact-half boundaries. It is about the content of the test suite, not about the behaviour of any exported function. The rounding itself is attacked by criterion 2.1.
coverage.text: THE Cart_Pricing_Library SHALL include tests for Round_Half_Up behavior at exact-half boundaries of `percentOf`.

coverage.reason: The criterion requires that tests avoid asserting which ValidationError is thrown first. It is a constraint on how tests are written, not on any exported function.
coverage.text: THE Cart_Pricing_Library SHALL include tests that avoid asserting which ValidationError is thrown first when multiple fields are invalid.

coverage.reason: The criterion requires that package.json, tsconfig.json, vitest.config.ts and test/setup.ts stay unchanged. It is about project files outside src/ and no exported function can show a change to them.
coverage.text: THE Cart_Pricing_Library SHALL leave `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `vitest.config.ts`, and `test/setup.ts` unchanged.
